items.title: The Similars
items.reason: Eight strangers are trapped at a remote bus station during an abnormal worldwide storm and progressively confront an unexplained transformation that makes them share the same face. The mystery keeps changing shape across the runtime: possible illness or government involvement gives way to sealed exits, altered photographs and objects, a comic-book scenario about lost individuality, Ignacio's role in preventing escape, reality-altering abilities, the discovery that Ulises himself transformed first, and a broader memory/identity explanation. Whole-film reviews describe the feature as sustaining its premise with several additional twists. Its deliberately 1960s-styled presentation and substantial horror mode are meaningful negatives, but the central phenomenon, containment, unknown rules, suspense and repeated reframing remain dominant.
